name: NovaChem HazGuard Enforcement Full Kit
description: Acid-yellow and charcoal-grey sealed hazmat-tactical hybrid armor, with NovaChem's diamond-and-droplet logo printed in reflective silver across the chest plate and full-face respirator mask housing. The helmet is a positive-pressure sealed unit with integrated chemical sensor array and four-hour internal air supply, dual-purpose for enforcement and spill response. Load rig carries chemical dispersal grenades, a pressurized neutralizing agent sprayer, and restraint gear, all sealed in chemically inert pouches. Boots are fully sealed knee-high chemical-resistant composite, heat-bonded to the suit trousers with watertight gaskets.
functionality: Full chemical and biological hazard protection, integrated sensor array for compound identification, and enforcement-grade load capacity for riot and spill response.
what_it_says: NovaChem enforces its own cleanup standards — and decides what counts as a spill versus a suppression action.
story_hooks: A HazGuard unit's chemical sensor keeps reading an unknown compound at a site NovaChem officially declared clean six months ago.
Someone has been stealing the neutralizing agent canisters from HazGuard kits and replacing them with something that accelerates burns.

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding, geometric silhouette in high-visibility acid-yellow and charcoal-grey. The full-body sealed suit creates a rigid, modular appearance with distinct paneling. The oversized helmet dominates the upper body, featuring a smooth visor and mounted sensor array. The wearer appears as an industrial enforcer—part hazmat technician, part tactical operative. Reflective silver NovaChem branding (diamond-and-droplet motif) gleams across the chest plate.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tailored with reinforced articulation zones at shoulders, elbows, knees, and wrists. The suit is snug but allows tactical mobility. The helmet sits with a slight forward cant. Boots are integrated and rigid, extending to mid-calf with visible heat-bonded seam lines where they meet the trouser legs.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-grade synthetic composite with sealed inner layer; chemical-resistant polymer plating on vulnerable zones; boot material is reinforced composite with thermal-bonded gasket seals.
physical_description.texture: Smooth outer shell with fine ribbed paneling for flex; matte finish on armor plates with gloss reflective sections. Visible seam stitching throughout with silver metallic accent piping at major joints. Helmet visor has a slight honeycomb texture for optical clarity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Acid-yellow primary (high-visibility safety standard), charcoal-grey secondary structural panels and accents. Reflective silver logo printing and piping. Black visor tint. Muted olive drab on load rig pouch straps.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic sealed closure system running down the central torso seam; friction-fit wrist gaskets; heat-bonded boot-to-trouser seals with secondary mechanical locks at the ankles. Helmet sealed via quarter-turn threaded collar. Load rig uses quick-release buckles rated for chemical exposure.
distinctive_features: Integrated four-hour positive-pressure air supply in helmet crown
Dual-lens visor with built-in chemical sensor array (four optical apertures visible on helmet face)
Full-body sealed gasket system at wrists, neck, and ankle cuffs
NovaChem diamond-and-droplet logo printed in reflective silver across chest plate and helmet housing
Tactical load rig with sealed inert pouches for grenades, pressurized sprayer, and restraint gear
Reinforced knee and elbow plating with serrated grip texture
Heat-bonded boot-to-trouser integration with visible industrial stitching
Utility harness with color-coded chemical cartridge slots (visible yellow and grey pouches)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 corporate enforcement asset. Expensive specialty equipment owned by a megacorp division, but worn by working-class tactical operatives.
physical_description.cultural_context: NovaChem security personnel, hazmat response teams, or enforcement divisions handling industrial spills and corporate security breaches. Signals authority, technical competence, and corporate allegiance. The wearer is an instrument of corpo compliance.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained; visible minor scuff marks on armor plates from field use. Helmet visor may show faint residue from chemical mist or dust. All seals are functional and regularly inspected. Patches may appear on load rig pouches where chemical cartridges have been swapped.

image_prompt: A neo-noir hazmat enforcer in full NovaChem HazGuard kit stands against a dark industrial backdrop—concrete wall with faint chemical warning stencils. Acid-yellow and charcoal-grey sealed suit gleams under moody blue-and-orange neon strips. The oversized sealed helmet dominates, its dual-lens visor dark and inscrutable, with visible chemical sensor array mounted on the face. Reflective silver NovaChem diamond-and-droplet logo glows on the chest plate. Load rig pouches hang heavy at the sides, each sealed and color-coded. Boots are rigid, heat-bonded to trousers with visible industrial gasket seams. Soft rim lighting catches the glossy armor plating and sensor housings. The figure is completely sealed, utterly inhuman—a tactical tool of corporate compliance. Shot from mid-thigh up, slight low angle for dominance. Grainy, cinematic, neo-noir urban aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
